issues.message: Design specifies mobile-first approach with iOS/Android native patterns and bottom navigation, but technical requirements specify Web platform only (React, Node.js, Express). This is a fundamental platform mismatch.

No authentication or user management features defined in requirements, but database schema includes users table with authentication fields (email, username, password_hash). This creates scope ambiguity.
Design includes Profile screen with user account management, settings, and logout functionality, but no corresponding features exist in requirements (F1-F4 only cover task CRUD operations).
Non-functional requirements (NFRs) are completely missing. No specifications for performance, security, scalability, availability, or usability metrics.
Design specifies mobile-specific interactions (touch targets 44x44px, keyboard appearance handling, bottom navigation) but platform is Web. Responsive web design patterns differ from native mobile.
Database schema includes user authentication fields but no password reset, email verification, or session management tables that would typically be required for a complete authentication system.
Design includes filter functionality on Task List and Completed screens, but no filtering requirements are defined beyond status-based filtering in F4.
Character count limit (500 characters) specified for task description in design, but no such constraint exists in requirements or database schema (uses TEXT type with no limit).
Database schema uses UUID for primary keys but no justification provided in requirements for this choice over auto-incrementing integers for a simple task manager.

required_fixes: Align design platform approach with technical requirements: either change design to web-responsive patterns or update technical requirements to include mobile platforms
Add user authentication and account management features to requirements (F5, F6) or remove users table and related functionality from database and design
Remove Profile screen from design or add corresponding user management features to requirements
Define comprehensive non-functional requirements including performance targets, security requirements, data retention policies, and accessibility standards
Clarify scope: if authentication is required, add complete user management features; if not, simplify to single-user or sessionless architecture
Add database constraints for description character limit if 500-character limit is a requirement, or remove limit from design
recommendations: Consider adding a Feature F5 for User Authentication and F6 for User Profile Management to align all artifacts, or explicitly state this is a single-user application without authentication
Define NFRs including: response time targets (e.g., <200ms for task operations), concurrent user capacity, data backup frequency, browser compatibility requirements, and WCAG compliance level
Add task filtering and sorting requirements to match design capabilities (filter by date, search by title/description)
Consider adding soft delete functionality to allow task recovery, especially given the emphasis on delete confirmation in design
Specify security requirements such as password complexity rules, session timeout, HTTPS enforcement, and SQL injection prevention measures
Add error handling and validation requirements for all user inputs, including maximum lengths, special character handling, and XSS prevention
Consider adding task metadata features like tags, categories, or priority levels that are common in task management applications and would enhance user value
